messages.text: Handed to the team · Converting store credit to a card/PayPal refund needs Abel or Georges' approval.

I checked, Winson, and the $220.99 is already yours. When we swapped your BS-4 for the Thor P2 on October 29, it went onto your HeliumDeploy account as store credit. That balance comes off automatically at checkout on your next order.

You asked for it back on PayPal instead, and only the team can approve that. You've been waiting on that answer since October 29, and I'm sorry. I've sent it back to them with the full history. Someone will pick it up and reply to you by email.
ohhh.. i tot the $220.99 u will refund to my bank. i tot we already agreed

I understand, Winson, and I'm sorry for the confusion. When the swap went through on October 29, the system put the $220.99 on your account as store credit. You asked that same day to have it on your PayPal instead, and that request has been with the team since then.

I've told them you understood the refund to your bank was already agreed. Only they can move the money, so I can't confirm it myself. Someone will pick up your ticket and reply to you by email.
Thanks, Winson. The team will reply to you by email about the $220.99. Your Thor P2 is due November 24, so message me here when it arrives if you'd like help setting it up.
the store credit can keep how long ?

Your $220.99 store credit has no expiry date, Winson. It stays on your HeliumDeploy account until you use it, and it comes off automatically at checkout when you're logged in with this email.

Your request to move it to PayPal is still with the team. If they approve it, the money goes to your PayPal and the store credit comes off your account.

Is there any way to refund the payment back to the original credit card that I used to make the payment?

Alternatively, would a crypto transfer be possible?

Could you please help me check again? Thank you. good night
Handed to the team · Payout method decision and refund need Abel or Georges.

I've checked again, Winson. I can't move the $220.99 myself, so I can't say yet whether it can go back to your card or be sent as crypto. The team has your request now, with the card as your first choice and crypto as the other option. Someone will pick it up and reply to you by email.

Until then, the $220.99 stays on your account as store credit, and it doesn't expire. Good night, Winson.
